searchText: Is there a quide for noobs how to set up a validator for the upcoming testnet? I have no technical background but would like to participate in this historical moment and support the network 🙂 Thanks! <@456226577798135808> There will be a preview of the ETH 2.0 Deposit Launchpad website which is aimed at non-technical people. At the moment you can participate in the Altona testnet but need to follow the guides of the individual clients. It doesn't really make sense that it's aimed at non technical people but you need cli. The onboarding using the clients their guides is much more easier. To be really aimed at non technical people you need a gui and just one package to install. Just my two gwei
